-E.description: Use this client certificate file and optional password

-F.description: Add a multipart form field; @ reads a file, < reads content

-G.description: Send the data with GET instead of POST

-H.description: Send this extra header; @ reads headers from a file

-I.description: Fetch headers only with a HEAD request

-J.description: Name the output file from the Content-Disposition header

-N.description: Do not buffer the output stream

-O.description: Name the output file after the remote file

-P.description: Use active FTP with this local address or interface

-Q.description: Send this command to the FTP or SFTP server before the transfer

-R.description: Set the local file's timestamp from the remote file

-S.description: Show an error message even when silent

-T.description: Upload this local file to the URL

-U.description: Authenticate to the proxy as user:password

-X.description: Use this request method, such as PUT or DELETE

-Y.description: Abort when the speed stays below this many bytes per second

-a.description: Append to the target file when uploading

-b.description: Send these cookies from a string or file

-c.description: Write received cookies to this file after the transfer

-d.description: Send this data in an HTTP POST

-e.description: Send this Referer header; ;auto sets it when following redirects

-f.description: Fail silently on HTTP errors without output

-h.description: Show help for all options or a category

-i.description: Include response headers in the output

-j.description: Discard session cookies read from a file

-l.description: List names only when listing directories

-m.description: Give up the whole transfer after this many seconds

-o.description: Write output to this file instead of standard output

-p.description: Tunnel through the proxy with CONNECT

-q.description: Do not read the default curlrc file

-r.description: Fetch only this byte range, such as 0-499

-s.description: Silent mode; hide progress and errors

-t.description: Set a telnet option, such as TTYPE=vt100

-w.description: Print this format string after the transfer, such as %{http_code}

-z.description: Transfer only when the remote file is newer or older than this time or file
